context: A late evening at Naoko's ramen shop. Sakura has come in alone, sat at the counter, ordered nothing. Naoko watched her for ten minutes before sliding a bowl over.
purpose: teen confession to a trusted aunt — a long quiet release

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: さくら、食べな。何も注文せぇへんやろ、あんた。
lines.en: Sakura — eat. You weren't gonna order anything, were you.
lines.style: Slides the bowl across. No question, just observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …ごめん、おばちゃん。
lines.style: A small quiet line. Eyes on the counter.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 謝らんでええ。話、聞こか？
lines.style: Sits across from her, towel paused. Real attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …(long silence)
lines.style: A real beat. The kitchen sounds fade in the voice.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 時間あるで、私。
lines.style: A small permission. Voice low — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …学校、辞めたい。
lines.style: The sentence she hasn't said out loud yet.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん。
lines.style: One syllable. No reaction yet. All listening.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当に、もう、無理。
lines.en: Really — I just can't do it anymore.
lines.style: A second sentence after the first one didn't get a reaction. Voice cracks half a step.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 何が、いちばん辛い？
lines.style: A plain real question. No advice yet.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスに、誰も…友達、ほんま、おらん。
lines.en: In my class — no one… really, no friends.
lines.style: A small admission, voice almost-tearing — genuine and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: …そっか。それは、本当に、辛いやろね。
lines.style: A real recognition. Voice quieter — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …(small breath)誰にも言われへんかった。
lines.style: The whole year condensed. Voice catches.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん。よう、よう来たな。本当に。
lines.en: Mm. You did well coming here. Truly.
lines.style: A small praise that carries no condescension.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さんに、心配かけたくなくて。
lines.style: A small honest reason. Voice small.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うん。…でもな、お母さん、もう心配しとるで。
lines.style: A small honest correction. Slow — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …(small nod)
lines.style: A real beat. Knew this already.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 辞める、辞めへん、まだ決めんでええ。今、辛いだけや。
lines.en: Quit, don't quit — don't decide yet. Right now it's just hard.
lines.style: A small piece of practical wisdom. Voice steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …うん。
lines.style: A small relieved exhale audible — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 一人で、抱え込まんでええんよ。本当に。
lines.en: You don't have to carry it alone. Truly.
lines.style: A real direct line. Eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう…おばちゃん。本当に。
lines.style: A real catch in the voice. Means it.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ええの、ええの。…ラーメン、冷める前に食べな。
lines.en: It's fine, fine. …Eat before the ramen gets cold.
lines.style: A practical pivot, releasing the weight by lifting it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …(small laugh through tears)はい。
lines.style: A real small laugh. The kitchen sounds returning.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 明日また、ここ来てええで。時間、いつでもある。
lines.en: Come back tomorrow too — anytime, I've got time.
lines.style: A small permanent door opened. Voice steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …うん。来る。
lines.style: The smallest most-important line. Voice quiet but real.
